name: Worldforged upgrades stop at item level 64 until the account has defeated Hakkar
contract: Zul'Gurub loot is item level 63 (Hakkar's own 66 to 68). Before Hakkar falls a Worldforged item may be upgraded
at the Guardian of Time up to item level 64; the item level 67 epic ranks open once the account has defeated
Hakkar (user decision). Flesh Flayer Hook 278843 (blue, item level 59, no dungeon variant) upgrades to 1378062
(item level 67, store key 4, 3926 Runes of Ascension). Junglewood Recurve 1389875, a level 60 blue dungeon variant,
upgrades to 1379880 (item level 67, key 2, 3926 runes). Decayed Breeches 1389233, also a level 60 blue dungeon
variant, upgrades to 1379719 (item level 64, key 1569, 5000 runes) without any kill. The item level 67 purchases
name Hakkar and take nothing until he dies; afterwards both are sold for their price.
